_comment: Starter entries for a brand's expression dictionary — task-365, ADR-199.
Copied into a brand the first time its dictionary is used; after that
the brand owns its copy and edits it under Settings, Personalisation.
Changing this file later changes only brands that have not started yet.
Per language: cases, tried in order, then the fallback. A case tests one
recipient field (gender, first_name, last_name): filled, empty, or
equals a value; gender is female, male or diverse. A case applies only
when every field its text prints is filled; the fallback prints none.
